sources.title: Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.status: Provisional UK territorial annual and quarterly estimates
sources.verified_fact: The publication provides provisional 2025 UK territorial estimates by broad TES sector and fuel class and states that they will be revised when final estimates are published.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a latest-year territorial trend control without treating provisional values as final, facility or parcel measurements.

sources.title: 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions: provisional figures - statistical release
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.status: Sector, fuel, quarter, temperature and international transport detail
sources.verified_fact: The release defines the estimates as territorial, reports annual and quarterly sector and fuel breakdowns, and distinguishes residence and consumption measures published elsewhere.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an explicit measurement-basis guard and latest-year control totals.

sources.title: 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions: provisional figures - methodology summary
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.status: Energy, projection, held-constant, temperature and reliability methods documented
sources.verified_fact: The methodology separates estimates derived from provisional energy statistics, projections and held-constant components and documents reliability limits.
sources.quality_effect: Prevents provisional national estimates from being used as observed facility or parcel emissions.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: provisional
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: National Data Library official dataset catalogue
sources.status: 2025 release tables and methodology listed under OGL
sources.verified_fact: The catalogue lists the 2025 data tables, statistical release and methodology, and records that provisional figures are subject to final revision.
sources.quality_effect: Adds machine-readable resource discovery and licence traceability.

sources.title: Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gas emissions intensity by industry
sources.status: Industry intensity time series with revision and correction history
sources.verified_fact: The current dataset supplies industry intensity estimates through 2024 and exposes scheduled revisions and prior correction history.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an economic-intensity plausibility control while retaining the ONS residence-basis distinction.

sources.title: Carbon footprint for the UK and England to 2023
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.status: UK and England consumption emissions with correction history
sources.verified_fact: The release reports consumption-based UK and England footprints and explicitly compares consumption, territorial and production measures; a 7 July 2026 textual correction is recorded.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a consumption-basis guard so footprint totals are not substituted for territorial, facility or parcel values.

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme: technical guidance and tools
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: GOV.UK technical guidance, factors and reporting templates collection
sources.status: Current monitoring, reporting, verification and allocation guidance
sources.verified_fact: The collection provides current installation guidance, emission factors and reporting templates and records 2026 updates for waste monitoring and free-allocation reporting.
sources.quality_effect: Adds MRV and template controls for ETS candidate interpretation; guidance is not an emissions measurement dataset.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.status: Back-series method changes and estimated impacts documented
sources.verified_fact: The note explains that annual method improvements are applied back through the time series and distinguishes method effects from later activity-data revisions.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a revision-lineage control for comparing historical releases.
